consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: classification of a space and issue of an entry permit

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for CY-3211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on CY-3211 and PT-3211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in rescuing from a confined space, specifically planning and rehearsing non-entry rescue. CY-3211 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 7 October 2021 a planned critical control verification of CY-3211 and PT-3211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit not effective.
